ja252:1.1: Even today it’s in my mind,
ja252:1.2: what you (did) to me for a handful
ja252:1.3: Of sesame, taking me by the arm you beat me with a stick.
ja252:2.1: Do you not take delight in life,
ja252:2.2: brahmin, that you come by here,
ja252:2.3: Having taken ahold of my arms,
ja252:2.4: three times you did batter me.
ja252:3.1: The noble one doing the ignoble,
ja252:3.2: he who censors with a stick,
ja252:3.3: This is (right) instruction, not hatred, so the wise do understand.
